rdfs:label: alumniOf
rdfs:comment: An organization the person is an alumnus/alumna of — typically a school or university they attended; loosely also a former employer.
notes: Use for past educational and (loosely) professional affiliations. Repeat for multiple. Distinct from `urn:solid:worksFor` which implies *current* employment. Often pointed at a `urn:solid:EducationalOrganization` (university, school) but any past Organization works.

history.note: Comment tightened to schema.org's alumni sense; seeAlso uses urn:solid:EducationalOrganization.
